exposure: BMI under 18,5 kg/m(2) in early pregnancy
outcome: Risk of small for gestational age infants
cohort: 285 women with singleton pregnancy and a BMI <18.5 kg /m(2) who gave birth after 15 weeks of gestation, compared to 285 women with normal BMI
finding: Underweight women in early pregnancy experienced higher rates of anemia and small for gestational age infants, highlighting the need for adapted pregnancy follow-up.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in mode of delivery between underweight and normal BMI women.
